{{recipe}} 

== Ingredients ==
* 2 slices mesquite-smoked [[Cookbook:Turkey|turkey]] breast
* 2 slices white [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]]
* 6 strips [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], crisp cooked
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* 2 slices [[Cookbook:Monterey Jack Cheese|Monterrey Jack cheese]]

== Procedure ==
#Assemble a sandwich with the turkey, bread, bacon, and cheese. Set aside.
#Preheat 2-burner grill pan over medium high heat.
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] both sides of sandwiches with oil then place on grill.
#Cook until ingredients are heated through and bread is marked, turning as needed. Serve hot.
